title: The Telegram Reading Sequence
description:
Telegram dispatch timestamps:
Telegram A sent at 11:00 AM.
Telegram B sent at 11:20 AM.
Telegram C sent at 11:45 AM.
Receiver read Telegram B first, then Telegram A, then Telegram C.
question: Which telegram was read SECOND?
acceptable_answer_format:
Type only the telegram name.

Example:
Telegram A
hints: Reading sequence: 1st = Telegram B, 2nd = Telegram A, 3rd = Telegram C.
solution_explanation: The receiver read Telegram B first, Telegram A second, and Telegram C third. Telegram A was read second.
